cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in this flat, count five breaths with me. Slowly, please. That delivery-man pace isn't useful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five. Shall I shut the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while I'm still looking at you. We should have done this facing the kitchen. Stand beside me; we'll repeat it correctly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Stay until it boils, please. No, leave your cup in the box. I need to manage making just mine before you go.
